description: Department of Census & Statistics - Notifying the National Consumer Price Index, for the Month of May, 2017 was 121.8
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index for May 2017, computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. The content is purely statistical and informational, relating to economic data publication. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). This falls under general administrative/economic information dissemination, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
